newsitem.title: UK: EC's Carre expects ECB to adopt minimum reserves.
newsitem.headline: EC's Carre expects ECB to adopt minimum reserves.

text.p: A top official at the European Commission (EC) said on Thursday he expected the European Central Bank to adopt a policy of minimum reserves.
"I think they will go for it," Herve Carre, director of monetary matters for the EC told Reuters.
"The (Maastricht) Treaty provides for the possibility of minimum reserves," he said after speaking at a conference on European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) in London.

The European Monetary Institute, the precursor to the ECB, recently unveiled its monetary policy brief for EMU. But it left open the question of whether the ECB would use minimum reserves -- which require banks to deposit some funds at the central bank -- in its policy.
The Bundesbank has pushed hard for minimum reserves but other countries such as Britain reject the idea.
